item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 28/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will improve over the coast of southern China today and tomorrow, and it will be rather warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong between Tuesday night and Wednesday morning. Winds will strengthen from the north and the weather will become cool appreciably over the region on Wednesday. Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon, it will be rather cool in the morning over the region in the latter part of this week.
